subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw publish `CliBackendPlugin.parseJsonlEvent` as the supported plugin SDK contract for provider-specific JSONL streaming and display-only tool cards?
rationale: This is an additive external SDK surface with long-lived compatibility obligations; source review cannot determine whether maintainers want this capability or a narrower existing-plugin seam.

options.title: Sponsor the parser hook
options.body: Accept this opt-in SDK contract, then require real external-CLI proof and the normal compatibility review before merging.

options.title: Request a narrower seam
options.body: Define a smaller or differently owned plugin API if normalized parser events are too broad for the permanent SDK.

options.title: Decline the SDK expansion
options.body: Keep current built-in dialect handling and direct third-party integrations to existing supported plugin behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the parser hook
recommendation.body: Accept this opt-in SDK contract, then require real external-CLI proof and the normal compatibility review before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent reasoning-stream work makes this the best available routing candidate, although ownership confidence is low.
